name: footnote
title: Footnote
description: In-text citation marker + prose container composite. Multi-voice typography per CD1 Concept 5 — marker (Meta-code), prose (Body), back-link (Nav). Article-only sanctuary affordance per CD1 Concept 7. Four variants: sidebar-popover (desktop), mobile-bottom-sheet, endnote, inline-aside.

meta.primeForwardPointer: Sidebar/sheet open/close motion (sidebar slide-in ~200ms; bottom-sheet slide-up ~250ms) wires at CD5 round 2 ratification. Stateless open prop at W3-S-A; host-app coordinates state.
